title: MIP* = RE
abstract: A Lean 4 formalization of MIP* = RE (Ji, Natarajan, Vidick, Wright and Yuen): the class of languages decidable by a classical polynomial-time verifier interacting with two provers who share entanglement, with completeness 1 and soundness 1/2, is exactly the class of recursively enumerable languages. The development also contains the halting reduction behind it (a computable map from Turing machines to nonlocal games whose synchronous and quantum values are 1 if the machine halts and at most 1/2 otherwise) and its corollaries that the synchronous and the quantum value of a game are uncomputable. It builds on three other formalizations: the soundness of the classical low individual degree test (MIPStarRE, by Sirui Lu, Ruixuan Deng and Zhengfeng Ji, registered as PALOMAR-2026-08-18-000001), imported as a pinned Lake dependency, and the parallel repetition theorem for entangled strategies (ten-proofs, OpenAI) and the direct parallel repetition theorem for commuting-operator strategies (commuting-repetition), which are vendored with their provenance recorded. Palomar/Challenge.lean states the four compared theorems on top of Mathlib alone, in a tree-program model of polynomial time that the fidelity section describes; Palomar/Solution.lean proves them from the library.
